translations.text: Ranged Barracks — Ranged Heroes, T1 to T6 Unit Tiers, % Differences & Output.

Detailed breakdown of the Ranged Barracks (Level 24), all 14 Legendary Ranged commanders (Sebastian, Nova, Ethan, Sophie, Bard, Julia, Valeria Moretti, Lynne, Jacob, Chun, Nakano Maaya, Louis, Cedric, Spectra) with a Hero Pairing & Combo Calculator, T1–T6 troop tiers, and Basic vs. Advance squad buff calculations.
Trains backline high-DPS Ranged squads. Ranged units counter Infantry (Shield) squads and are vulnerable to fast Rider flanking marches.

Pair any two of the 14 Ranged commanders (Sebastian, Nova, Ethan, Sophie, Bard, Julia, Valeria, Lynne, Jacob, Chun, Nakano Maaya, Louis, Cedric, Spectra) to inspect combined stats, perks, and Lv 1–Lv 5 skills.
Visual progression from wooden bows to heavy anti-materiel sniper rifles.
Base stats, active commander/tech bonus, and total combat output (T1–T6).
